R01.title: Input/time/config/cooldown correctness
R01.minimum_proof: Section 2.3 regressions, invalid books, timestamp semantics, restarted cooldown, quiet mode, finite CLI arguments

R02.title: Calculation kernel
R02.minimum_proof: Hand-derived buy/sell/fee/precision fixtures, base sell and per-child fixed fees; budget and per-venue/currency conservation; depth/limits/residuals/units

R03.title: Two real public spot connectors
R03.minimum_proof: Metadata/markets and live ticker/book/stream; identity, connector-specific sequence/checksum/depth integrity, gap/resync, unchanged-live vs stalled channel, honest fallback

R04.title: Durable capture/replay foundation
R04.minimum_proof: Kill/restart transaction tests, migration restore, atomic archives, two identical replay hashes, corruption/gap handling

R05.title: Complete opportunity capability
R05.minimum_proof: Positive/negative/rejected/unknown; every delay; continuous vs sampled persistence including 250-ms disappearance/750-ms recovery, threshold/profile/gap fixtures; complete replay vs sanitized limits; versioned replay

R06.title: Complete diagnostics
R06.minimum_proof: Every fault detected with declared rules/counts/windows; visible incident grouping/recovery/closure/pin/export; offline bundle reproduces expected findings

R07.title: Complete cost advisor
R07.minimum_proof: Buy/sell grid, fees/units/limits, ineligible reasons, inventory/rebalance and split-depth conservation

R08.title: Complete consumer UI
R08.minimum_proof: All destinations/states/themes/widths, accessibility/dials/before-after; installed first-launch configuration/change/original replay/pause/restart journey

R10.title: Privacy/security
R10.minimum_proof: No unexpected egress/trading/telemetry; CSP/capabilities; unsafe import and secret/export checks; dependency/license review

R11.title: Clean reproducible automated gates
R11.minimum_proof: Fresh install/locks, lint/type/unit/integration/replay/IPC/UI/build checks, CI at candidate identity; required skips fail

R12.title: Continuous-run reliability
R12.minimum_proof: One uninterrupted 24-hour awake-host live profile, final bound report, resources/coverage and separate induced-fault recovery

R13.title: Installable compatibility
R13.minimum_proof: macOS 13+ evidence, arm64 and x86_64 builds and native checks on both; no developer runtime required

R14.title: GitHub distribution readiness
R14.minimum_proof: Developer ID signing, accepted notarization, stapling, Gatekeeper, quarantined clean-user install; GPL/notices/matching source

R15.title: Final evidence and audit
R15.minimum_proof: Candidate/config/artifact bindings, every row proven, three review roles resolved/revalidated, truthful materials, no required prerequisite missing

R16.title: Real-time WebSocket full-duplex streaming
R16.minimum_proof: Kraken book v2 and Coinbase Advanced Trade WS; incremental orderbook maintenance, CRC32 checksum comparison, sequence-gap REST resync, bounded backoff reconnect; 14 integration tests including concurrency, reconnect churn, and bounded memory

R17.title: End-to-end native user journeys
R17.minimum_proof: Cold start, market load, depth comparison, deterministic offline replay, diagnostics bundle export, theme persistence across reload, quiet mode suppression decoupled from macOS notification delivery; 8 Playwright E2E tests

R18.title: Dual-architecture CI/CD with enforced gates
R18.minimum_proof: ci.yml and release.yml with Python 3.12, Node 22, Rust 1.90+; aarch64-apple-darwin and x86_64-apple-darwin matrix; verify.py and release.py as blocking gates; GPL corresponding source published once

R19.title: Soak reliability with resource bounds
R19.minimum_proof: Continuous run with live WS streams, RSS peak bounded <= 512 MiB, real REST latency p50/p95/p99 quantiles recorded
